user.title: Zetlight Horizon Aqua LED
user.description: Pick a discovered light, or choose "Enter IP manually".

manual.title: Zetlight Horizon Aqua LED
manual.description: Enter the light's local IP address. Tip: reserve its address in your router's DHCP settings so it doesn't change.

error.cannot_connect: No reply from the light. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant can reach the device on the UDP port.

init.title: Schedule presets
init.description: Define named presets as YAML. Each preset has `start` (HH:MM), `durations` (5 slot lengths in minutes) and `brightness` (5 slots x 4 channels A,B,C,D, 0-100). Selecting a preset overwrites the device's stored program.

error.invalid_presets: Could not parse the presets. Check the YAML and that each preset has 5 slots of 4 channel values.
